mapper.select: with ranked as ( select case when m.from_user_id = #{userId} then m.to_user_id else m.from_user_id end as partner_id, m.content, m.create_time, row_number() over ( partition by case when m.from_user_id = #{userId} then m.to_user_id else m.from_user_id end order by m.create_time desc, m.message_id desc ) as row_num from lf_private_message m where (m.from_user_id = #{userId} or m.to_user_id = #{userId}) and m.content_status = 'VISIBLE' and m.del_flag = '0' ), unread as ( select from_user_id as partner_id, count(1) as unread_count from lf_private_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0' and content_status = 'VISIBLE' and del_flag = '0' group by from_user_id ) select r.partner_id as to_user_id, u.nick_name as nickname, r.content as last_msg, r.create_time as last_time, coalesce(unread.unread_count, 0) as unread from ranked r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.partner_id left join unread on unread.partner_id = r.partner_id where r.row_num = 1 order by r.create_time desc

select message_id, conversation_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, content_status, read_flag, create_time, del_flag from lf_private_message where ((from_user_id = #{userId} and to_user_id = #{otherUserId}) or (from_user_id = #{otherUserId} and to_user_id = #{userId})) and content_status = 'VISIBLE' and del_flag = '0' order by create_time asc, message_id asc limit 200

select message_id, conversation_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, content_status, read_flag, create_time, del_flag from lf_private_message where message_id = #{messageId} and content_status = 'VISIBLE' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into lf_private_message ( conversation_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, content_status, read_flag, create_time, del_flag ) values ( #{conversationKey}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, 'VISIBLE', '0', sysdate(), '0' )
